newsitem.title: USA: Chromatics gets OK for Colormate device.
newsitem.headline: Chromatics gets OK for Colormate device.

text.p: Chromatics Color Sciences International Inc said Wednesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved its Colormate device for commercial distribution in the U.S.
The company said it received a "substantial equivalence" determination order for the device that monitors Bilirubin infant jaundice from the FDA's Center for Devices and Radiological Health.
Chromatics said it intends to comply with any applicable general controls and special controls to which the device may be subject.

The company added the order states it must comply with the medical device general controls, such as device establishment registration; medical device listing; good manufacturing practices; labeling; and the statutory prohibitions against adulteration and misbranding.
The company also said the device, which is classified as a Class II device, may be subject to additional special controls.
The company's stock rose to eight Wednesday around midday, up 5/8.
